thag2.20:1.1: Pare ca naṃ pasaṃsanti attā ce asamāhito: moghaṃ pare pasaṃsanti, attā hi asamāhito. || ||
thag2.20:2.1: pare ca naṃ garahanti attā ce susamāhito: moghaṃ pare garahanti, attā hi susamāhito. || || Sirimā thero. Vaggo dutiyo.
thag2.20:3.0: uddānaṃ: Cundo ca Jotidāso ca thero Heraññakāni yo Somamitto Sabbamitto Kālo Tisso ca Kimbilo Nando ca Sirimā c' eva dasa therā mahiddhikā 'ti.
